task:
MuseScore 3 is already open with the file /home/user/Documents/fanfare.mscz. The score has 4 measures of quarter notes and the current Composer is 'Anonymous'.

Perform these steps in order:
1. Open File > Score Properties. Change the Composer to exactly: Test Composer. Click OK.
2. Save the score with Ctrl+S so the updated composer is written into /home/user/Documents/fanfare.mscz.
3. Open File > Export.... Set the format to 'Standard MIDI File (*.mid)' and set the destination path to exactly /home/user/Documents/fanfare.mid. Click Export.
4. Open File > Export... again. Set the format to 'Uncompressed MusicXML (*.musicxml)' and set the destination path to exactly /home/user/Documents/fanfare.musicxml. Click Export.
5. Open File > Export... one more time. Set the format to 'PDF File (*.pdf)' and set the destination path to exactly /home/user/Documents/fanfare.pdf. Click Export.

All three exports must land at the exact paths shown. The original fanfare.mscz must still exist with the updated composer. The MIDI must contain at least 2 notes, the MusicXML must have at least 1 part, and the PDF must have a valid %PDF- header.

verification.description: Exported fanfare.pdf exists and has %PDF- header

cli_feasibility.translation: Modify composer metadata via XML editing (unzip .mscz, edit metaTag, repackage), then use mscore command-line for exports
cli_feasibility.reason: Metadata editing is simple XML manipulation; exports can use mscore --export-to command-line interface
